en.headline: Police arrest 31 in Yau Tsim raid targeting illegal workers and vice
en.dek: Officers and Immigration Department staff searched multiple locations in the district on Wednesday under operation CHAMPION, detaining people suspected of overstaying and illegal employment.
body: Police said the Yau Tsim district and the Immigration Department conducted a joint operation codenamed CHAMPION on Wednesday targeting illegal labour and vice activities.
Officers raided multiple locations and arrested 31 people aged between 21 and 54. The group included 24 mainland women, two mainland men, three non-Chinese men and two non-Chinese women.

Those arrested are suspected of overstaying, breaching conditions of stay or engaging in illegal employment. All remain detained for investigation, with some cases to be followed up by the Immigration Department, police said.

zh.headline: 油尖區打擊黑工及掃黃行動拘31人
zh.dek: 油尖警區聯同入境處周三在區內展開代號「冠軍」行動，突擊搜查多處，拘捕涉嫌逾期居留及非法勞工的人士。
body: 警方表示，油尖警區聯同入境事務處人員周三在區內展開代號「冠軍」的打擊非法勞工及掃黃行動，突擊搜查區內多個地點。
行動中共拘捕31人，年齡介乎21至54歲，包括24名內地女子、2名內地男子、3名非華裔男子及2名非華裔女子。
被捕人士分別涉嫌逾期居留、違反逗留條件及非法勞工。所有被捕人現正被扣留調查，部分稍後將交由入境處跟進，警方說。
